title: Theory of Spectroscopic Methods: Main Exam, December 2018
school: School of Pure and Applied Sciences
department: Department of Physical and Mathematical Sciences
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

parts.text: Define spectroscopy.
Differentiate between:
Absorption and emission of electromagnetic radiation
Chromophore and auxochrome
Bathochromic shift and hyposochromic shift
Rayleigh scattering and Raman Effect
Stokes lines and anti-stokes lines
The excitation potential for the (4p) level in calcium was 4.73x10-19.
Calculate the frequency in corresponding to the transition from 4p back to 4s ground state.
Find the wavenumber of this transition.
A proton has resonance 90Hz down field from TMS when the field strength is 1.41 T and the oscillator frequency is 60mHz.
Calculate the magnetogyric ratio .
What will be the shift in Hertz if the strength is increased to 2.82 Tesla and the oscillator frequency to 120mHz.
What will be the chemical shift ( ) in ppm.
Molecules can be considered to be rigid bodies. Give the four types of rigid bodies giving example of a molecule for each.
State Beer-Lambert's law and define all its terms giving their units.
A coloured complex has a molar absorptivity of 6.74x103 litre cm-1mol- 1. If the optical path is 25 mm and the percentage transmittance of 7.77, what will be the concentration of the solution?
Give and explain the three classes of deviations from Beer-Lamberts law.
Indicate true or false to each of the following.
Infrared spectroscopy provides information about the kinds of functional groups in a molecule.
Infrared spectroscopy only indicates what kind of hydrogen atoms a molecule contains.
When a compound absorbs IR energy the hydrogen nuclei reverse their direction of spin.
A compound absorbs IR energy only when the energy of the radiation exceeds the energy required to cause bonds to vibrate.
Which one of these bonds: C-N, C=N and C N, has the highest/largest infrared vibrational frequency? Explain briefly.
From the following data, k=1000kg.s-2, Atomic mass of C=12, N=14, Avogadro's constant = 6.022x1023 particles/mole. Calculate the vibrational wavenumber (cm-1) of the C=N stretching vibration.
Explain one way in which a solid sample is prepared in IR spectroscopy.
Give two advantages of Raman spectroscopy over IR spectroscopy.
Give a detector that can be used in IR spectroscopy.

items.text: Using a well-illustrated Jablonski diagram explain the following terms. i) Vibrational relaxation ii) Internal conversion iii) External conversion iv) Intersystem crossing v) Fluorescence vi) Phosphorescence
